hunks.baseline: Every step he had taken along that path.

hunks.baseline: But even Jeok Cheongang didn’t know what to say in this moment.

hunks.baseline: He could not let the moment his Disciple had bought with his life go to waste. He had to trust the vitality of the boy who had survived, as if by miracle, in every kind of hell.

hunks.baseline: The air burned. The moisture evaporated.

hunks.baseline: At its end—
hunks.sol: At the end of that moment—

hunks.baseline: Not one person was spared.

hunks.sol: Now here I was, sprawled like a corpse, feeling my senses slip away one by one as I waited to die.

hunks.sol: Even if it took me after that, I wanted time to say goodbye. I prayed desperately to see, just once more, the faces of the people whose lives had become bound to mine. My family.
